Magic of Mutual Funds
The Nifty 50 fell over 12% in two years, while the ICICI Prudential Multi Asset Allocation Fund delivered positive returns of around 9.5% over the same period. How did this happen despite holding some familiar stocks?
In this video, we explain how multi-asset allocation funds work, why asset allocation and rebalancing matter, and how equity, debt, and gold can influence portfolio performance.
